frame_row: At least two distinct-line contexts; maximum capacity remains open.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_tile_coh_adapter
(m_vlsit_riscv_tile_coh_adapter)
blocks.function: Adapts each hart's cache request/response and tagged probe boundary; repeated once per active hart.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_coh_txn_table
(m_vlsit_riscv_coh_txn_table)
blocks.function: Tracks independent line contexts, requester, line lock, unique active tag, holder mask, matching responses, dirty-data obligation and LLC completion; at least two distinct lines may be active.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_sharer_directory
(m_vlsit_riscv_sharer_directory)
blocks.function: Returns a conservative per-line holder set and commits metadata with cache fill, downgrade, invalidation and eviction events; independent-entry banking/ports, capacity and replacement are open.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_probe_scheduler
(m_vlsit_riscv_probe_scheduler)
blocks.function: Schedules probes for multiple tagged contexts only to directory-selected holders and associates each response/data beat with its active transaction; per-cache depth is open.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_device_classifier
(m_vlsit_riscv_device_classifier)
blocks.function: Separates non-cacheable device transactions from cacheable memory according to the SoC address/attribute contract.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_axi_mmio
(m_vlsit_riscv_axi_mmio)
blocks.function: Carries uncached device traffic to the external AXI4 fabric and returns responses without allocating cache lines.

interfaces.name: Tile coherent request service
interfaces.signals: Cacheable address, operation, requester, data and returned grant/response; exact cache records remain source-mapping dependencies.

interfaces.name: Sharer directory lookup and update
interfaces.signals: Physical line lookup, conservative holder bitmap, committed fill/downgrade/invalidation/eviction update, and transaction association.

interfaces.name: Tagged probe scheduling
interfaces.signals: Transaction tag, physical line, selected holder mask, probe operation, response mask and dirty-data obligation.

interfaces.name: Targeted D-cache probes
interfaces.signals: Tagged probe request and matching response/data; per-cache outstanding depth is TBD.

interfaces.name: AXI4 peripheral route
interfaces.signals: AXI4 transaction channels; the SoC fabric decodes targets.

interfaces.name: Per-hart tile boundary
interfaces.signals: Replicated coherent request/response and tagged local-probe boundary; exact source pins are TBD.

interfaces.name: Shared LLC line service
interfaces.signals: Line read/write, refill, dirty writeback, error and completion; exact port mapping is TBD.

interfaces.name: PMU coherence event taps
interfaces.signals: Implemented directory, transaction, probe, dirty-owner and wait events; selector IDs remain open.
